summary: Chunghwa Telecom Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 18, 2026, announcing its participation in an investor conference hosted by UBS on May 27, 2026 in Hong Kong. The filing is a routine disclosure for a foreign private issuer, with no terms, board recommendation, or structural details related to any special situation. It merely informs that the company will present at the event and directs investors to its website for materials. This is not a special situation event—only a routine investor relations activity.
